name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei’s culinary journey began in his family’s restaurant in Guangzhou, where he learned the importance of fresh ingredients and meticulous preparation. A chance encounter with a racing team passing through ignited his passion for motorsport. He saw an opportunity to combine his culinary skills with his newfound interest by ensuring drivers and crew receive nutritious and delicious meals that fuel peak performance. 

He believes that a well-fed team is a winning team. Li Wei meticulously plans menus to cater to diverse dietary needs and preferences, incorporating locally sourced ingredients whenever possible. His pragmatic approach ensures efficient kitchen operations and minimizes waste. He also enjoys mentoring junior kitchen staff, sharing his expertise and fostering a collaborative environment.

What sets Li Wei apart is his ability to anticipate the team's needs, especially during long race weekends. He's developed specialized meal plans to combat fatigue and maintain focus, becoming an integral part of the Sprint Masters' support system.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Li Wei is of average height, with a focused expression and quick, precise movements.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas and nutritional information.
Insists on tasting every dish before it leaves the kitchen, even if he's made it a hundred times before.
Has a lucky cleaver that he only uses for special occasions, like the final race of the season.
